decisions.mark: explains that `skipSync: true` stops the single incoming reaction being treated as the post's complete set — without it every other reaction on the post would be deleted
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "`sanitizeReactions` returns before computing `deleteReactions` (`utils/reaction.ts:49`). Without it, every local reaction on the post that is absent from the one-item payload would be marked for deletion." | WHY: The answer states that skipSync prevents the single-reaction payload from being treated as the full set, which would otherwise delete all other reactions on the post. || QUOTE: "`skipSync: true` ... `sanitizeReactions` returns before computing `deleteReactions` (`utils/reaction.ts:49`).
